name: MKVForge – Swift 6.2.4
install:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl binutils git gnupg2 libc6-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libedit2 libgcc-13-dev libncurses6 libpython3-dev libsqlite3-dev libstdc++-13-dev libxml2-dev libz3-dev pkg-config tzdata unzip zlib1g-dev mkvtoolnix
if ! swift --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'Swift version 6.2.4 '; then
  sudo rm -rf /usr/local/usr
  sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/swift /usr/local/bin/swiftc /usr/local/bin/swift-build /usr/local/bin/swift-test /usr/local/bin/swift-package
  curl -fsSL https://download.swift.org/swift-6.2.4-release/ubuntu2404/swift-6.2.4-RELEASE/swift-6.2.4-RELEASE-ubuntu24.04.tar.gz | sudo tar -xz -C /usr/local --strip-components=2
fi
swift --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'Swift version 6.2.4 ' || { echo 'Swift 6.2.4 is not first on PATH' >&2; swift --version >&2 || true; exit 1; }
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/mkv-forge' ] || (cd '/agent/repos/mkv-forge' && swift build)
